en.Privacy body: KinetMinutes runs entirely on your Mac. Recording, transcription and summarization all happen locally. Your audio and notes never leave this computer — the app makes no server calls.
en.Data location body: Audio, transcripts and notes are stored under ~/Library/Containers/com.kinet.minutes.app/. You can delete everything at any time.
en.This permanently removes all recordings,: This permanently removes all recordings, transcripts and notes on this Mac. This cannot be undone.
en.Choose a transcription model in Settings: Choose a transcription model in Settings to enable notes.
en.Free plan limit: Free plan: %d of %d notes used this month.
